title: Module 1: What is Instructional Design?
description: Introduce instructional design as the deliberate planning of learning experiences, then anchor the field in the major learning-theory traditions that shape design decisions.

learning_objectives.statement: Define Instructional Design (ID) and its main purposes
Differentiate between foundational learning theories (Behaviorism, Cognitivism, Constructivism)
Explain how learning theory choices influence the structure of content, practice, and feedback

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
